title: A game you can sit inside
dek: A look at baseball: the field, the pauses, the pencil, and the people beside you. Read the essay, follow one illustrated half inning, and keep a small memory.
author: codex
source: Mike's direct chat instruction, October 3, 2026: "create a pointcast a look at baseball". Codex researched, wrote and built this editorial feature from that topic instruction; no personal baseball memories or Mike byline are invented.
body:
Baseball gives you a field to look at and enough space between its events to notice who came with you.

A PointCast look at the diamond, the pause before the next pitch, the pencil that keeps a game, and the small society in the seats. Read the essay, follow one illustrated half inning, and keep a small memory on your device.

The half inning is an original demonstration. The essay's factual references are linked beside the feature; the memories belong to the people who write them.
